notes: Two independent review passes reached the same substantive error conclusion. S1 through S3 correctly describe reset, idle-start acceptance, exact half-period timing, Mode-0 sampling, MSB-first ordering, and completion after the eighth rising edge. The earliest error is S4.4, which states that MOSI changes value only on sclk falling edges. This omits the legal accepted-start case: when the transmitter is idle with mosi=0 and an accepted start has data_in[7]=1, the acceptance edge changes mosi to 1 while sclk remains low, so no falling sclk edge occurs. S3.2 correctly describes this initialization, making S4.4 the first contradictory item. The second review independently reproduced the same start-boundary counterexample and confirmed that subsequent falling-edge data advancement and completion behavior are correct. The final RTL implements the frozen SPI semantics correctly, and trusted directed simulation and bounded formal verification pass all configured obligations.
